name: Transmission, Gearbox & Drivetrain
disclaimer: Transmission repairs are highly specialized. Low or burnt transmission fluid can rapidly destroy internal clutch packs and torque converters.

symptoms: Engine revs high before gear engages
Slipping out of gear while accelerating
Delayed engagement when shifting from Park to Drive/Reverse
potentialCauses: Worn clutch packs or valve body solenoids
subtopics.criticalWarning: Severe slippage generates intense heat that burns transmission clutches quickly.
triageQuestions: Is the vehicle an automatic, dual-clutch (DCT), CVT, or manual?
Does the delay happen when cold or after the car warms up?
subtopics.recommendedAction: Transmission fluid level/condition check, diagnostic scan for transmission control module (TCM) codes.

symptoms: Hard jolt or bang when car changes gears
triageQuestions: Do you hear a loud thud or clunk when putting it in Reverse or Drive?
Does it happen in all gears or between specific gears (e.g. 1st to 2nd)?
subtopics.recommendedAction: Drivetrain mount inspection and TCM solenoid pressure testing.

symptoms: Sweet burnt toast smell from under vehicle
triageQuestions: Do you see red or dark brown fluid leaking in the middle-to-front underside?
subtopics.recommendedAction: Stop driving immediately if fluid level is depleted; repair leak and perform complete fluid flush.

triageRules: Never advise continuing long highway trips when transmission is actively slipping.
Recommend fluid analysis and TCM diagnostic scan.
